t3_definition.quote: R2a 最终Q正确源字节一点质量、q_null=gamma=0 时，正确字节概率 f64≥1−1e-12、f32≥1−1e-6
t3_definition.failure_rule: 失败先查干预和映射，不能用追加位置训练代替
t3_definition.intervention: alpha one-hot gold record, beta one-hot gold byte position of that record, gamma_override=0, q_null=0
t3_definition.population: 40 dev examples x 18 record steps = 720 steps
t3_definition.gate: f64 >= 1-1e-12 and f32 >= 1-1e-6 at every record step
t3_definition.excluded: argmax(a_hard) vs gold route is not T3; kept only as route_agreement

unforced_gold_probability.note: includes the generated branch, not copy alone

failure_layer.explanation: one-hot alpha/beta is spread by reader._transport, whose rows are softmax, not the identity; the arm has no post-transport R2a point-mass insertion
